items.html: And afterwards, on the first weekday, she returned to the second aspect, and was a complete Partzuf of ten Sefirot, in the back of the chest of ZA; and the first five Sefirot of ZA still did not illuminate in her. And this matter continued from the creation of the first man until Israel came out of Egypt: for on every Shabbat she returns with him face to face, equal for equal, in the sixth aspect mentioned above; and on weekdays she would return back to back, a complete Partzuf, in the second aspect mentioned above, and the five lights of ZA did not illuminate in her. And this continued until the exodus of Israel from Egypt, on the night of Passover.
